thread:
anya: quick follow-up from the postmortem 19: main ask is to close remaining action items on the KV memory/OOM flares. keeping this thread just for owner updates.

lucas: i'll take the heap-scan + allocation heatmaps. plan: run intermittent heap-dumps and a 1:200 sampled alloc trace on canary-1.

anya: lucas, please focus on both native buffers and tracked arena leaks. include histogram by size-class.

marco: i'll own the runtime guard work: add 'soft_shard_cap' and prioritized eviction by earliest-write. prototype config: `kv.soft_shard_cap=0.78` and `evict.strategy=write_age`.

marco: i'll also wire a short-circuit that replies to autoscaler to stop scale-down if node resident > 70%. should reduce cascade.

infra-bot: incident-bot: observed repeat pattern on clusters: eu-prod-2, us-east-1, canary-1. median time-to-oom 68h over last 5 incidents. see chart: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv/oom-trends

tiffany: for fragmentation experiments i propose two runs: (1) jemalloc aggressive decay + background purging, (2) enable slab compaction with 5m idle threshold. metrics: resident_growth_slope_24h and compaction_reclaim_pct.

lucas: starting heatmap now. command: `GCORE_DIR=/tmp/cores REDWOOD_TRACE=alloc:sample=200 ./runtime --shard=canary-1` will push to `s3://redwood-eng/kvcache/heap/2191110000/`

anya: add pprof and a short note on any large pinned objects discovered. also flag any suspicious C/C++ allocations from third-party libs.

marco: mitigation plan (short-term):
- enable `kv.evict_on_high_commit=true` on dedicated pools
- soft caps on shards
- autoscale throttle to stop aggressive scale-in
will flip on canary after lucas posts initial scan.

lucas: ETA: initial flamegraphs + top-20 allocation callsites by Tue AM. if we see a single dominant path, i'll file a PR to fix.

tiffany: running variant (1) on canary-1 now. will run 48h to collect slope metrics. variant (2) scheduled after variant (1) completes.

anya: alerts: change threshold to warn at 55% and trigger a `kv_mem.suspect_slope_12h` alert. ryan from SRE can you vet? (cc ryan)

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled to canary-1 at 2026-04-02T02:15Z. auto-rollback: resident > 82% for 10m.

marco: status update: soft_cap feature implemented in runtime, branch pushed: `feat/soft-cap-evict`. smoke tests passed on staging.

lucas: status: heap dumps uploaded -> s3://redwood-eng/kvcache/heap/2191110000/dumps.tar.gz. flamegraph link posted in the doc. initial signal shows multiple small callsites, no single huge leak yet.

tiffany: status: variant (1) halfway through, resident slope down ~22% after enabling background purge. running remainder of 24h.

anya: action tracker (short):
- lucas: heap-scan + flamegraphs (due Tue AM)
- tiffany: fragmentation runs + metrics (due Thu EOD)
- marco: soft-cap rollout + autoscale throttle prototype (due Wed)
- anya: consolidate and update PM tracker (due next Mon)

marco: note: added `evict.log_hint=true` to runtime for visibility when soft_cap triggers. will add dashboard panel.

infra-bot: reminder: weekly follow-up sync scheduled Thu 11:00.

anya: thanks all. keep updates short here. if anyone hits blockers call it out immediately. :thumbsup:
